[quote=pantagruel;58284764][spoiler=Prologue]Pantagruel, the strongest country in all of Erene, was a politically isolated country. With no outside ties between the state and any other country on Erene, Pantagruel was known as the Hermit kingdom. But this didnt stop it from becoming the strongest country in all of Erene, a robust power not even UREV could dare face. And so with all of this power, Pantagruel was bound to soon abuse it against any other foreign kingdom they could muster their hands upon. 
[/spoiler]
[spoiler=Invasion Imminent
Natural Expansion
1205 words][1.23.25]
At 0120, an armed coalition force of over 2,000 strong breached Pantagruelian borders. In the east, Pantagrueli Border Defense Forces(PBDF) would report over 200 Pantagruelian soldiers being killed in an armed ambush by the hostile coalition force, also known as the Amarallo Peoples Liberation Resistance(APLR). By 0220, APLR forces would capture the Haneul railway Hub. A small military railway center that connected the Pantagrueli Border Defense Force (PBDF) to multiple different military barracks and arms depots. This would prove to be a major blow to the Pantagrueli Military which would cause over 1,000 Pantagrueli soldiers to be routed and forced to surrender within the first 2 hours of fighting. 

By 0340, the Pantagrueli Minister of Defense, Hyong Yong-Chol. Would release a formal declaration of hostilities between the Pantagrueli Military and the Amarallo Peoples Liberation Resistance (APLR). By 0400, an armed convoy containing the 53rd Motorised Regiment and the 11th Tank Battalion would be en-route from Pyongyang to the remote village of Haneul to create an organized retaliation against the invading forces. By 0720, the Pantagrueli 53rd Motorised regiment would reach the city and directly respond to the invading APLR. A firefight would take place between the two militaries that would last 9 hours until the 11th Tank Battalion would arrive to provide assisting support for the 53rd Regiment. All Pro-APLR forces would be expelled from Pantagrueli territory in the East by 1830, and all captured Pantagrueli forces would be linked and emancipated from their invading captors. 

At 2230, Pantagrueli Minister of Defense Hyong Yong-Chol would dispatch General Pak Ryun-sek to be in charge of the annihilation of APLR forces in the East.

In the West, invading APLR forces would be put through an even more brutal resistance compared to the East. Western forces would violate the border only 2 days later only to advance 600 meters towards the major population center of the Seonghwado district. Where expecting Pantagrueli forces to fiercely defend with a mechanised retaliation. The Pantagruelians were able to hijack and perform espionage on APLR communications which allowed for the Pantagruelis to collect intel on the next APLR invasion. Pantagruelians to fortify the west in the scenario of the impending western APLR campaign.  

[1.29.25]
Only 6 days after the APLR violated the Pantagrueli borders and declared hostilities between the two states, all APLR military assets located in both the West and the East would be hindered by Pantagrueli ballistic missile strikes, which would target Arm Depots, General Quarters, and Logistical Centers. These strikes would prove extremely effective against the APLR as they didnt own any assets that could intercept the precision strikes.

At 0720, General Pak Ryun-sek, referred by Minister of Defense, Hyong Yong-Chol would officially begin the Eastern campaign to annihilate the APLR and conquer the lands. 6 armored convoys woud take the Gukcheong Expressway which would directly lead to Haemyung Port that would allow for the Pantagrueli Armed Forces (PAF/Green Army) to directly split in half all APLR forces. By 0800, approximately  7,000 troops along with 300 armored vehicles of both Tanks and AFVs would successfully breach the border and by 0840. Pantagrueli armed forces would take control of the Gukcheong Expressway. But these victories wouldnt come without APLR forces as a combiend guerilla assault would ambush the 6th Convoy at 1000. Leaving it to fend for itself while the remaining Pantagruei forces would continue the advancement. By 1120, after an hour of brutal fighting the 6th Armored Battalion would successfully ward off the attacking Guerillas and retreat back to Pantagrueli borders to resupply and repair damaged units. By 1730, the Green Army would reach the outskirts of Haemyung Port, the command center of the Eastern APLR. APLR forces would desperately put up a rag tag fortified defense to potentially retard any Pantagrueli assualt. And by 1800, Pantagrueli forces would breach the city and begin a 16 hour battle for Haemyung. The APLR would defend the city fiercely and even begin to start pushing the Pantagrueli assault to the outskirts of the city.  By 2300, General Pak Ryun-sek would authorise the use of Aerial and Strategic batteries to water down the APLR defense. The missile strikes would strike the key areas of defense and strongholds of the city, but would steer clear of the Port which was valuable for increasing the Pantagrueli Naval influence all around Amarallo. 

[1.30.25]
Between the times of 1300 and 1400 remaining APLR resistance would begin to simmer down due to the brutal Pantagrueli assualt. An armored platoon would enter the Command Center of the APLR and seize control of Haemyung, while also capturing APLR leader Jin Seok-ho. This would prove extremely valuable in levying the remaining APLR forces to surrender and for others to forfeit the city and flee to other lands. By 1800, after one week of brutal fighting between the APLR and Pantagruel, APLR commander Jin Seok-ho would order his forces to unconditionally surrender to the PAF. Both forces in the West and East would drop all weapons and flee occupied territories. General Pak Ryun-sek would be promoted and appluaded for his calculated and triumphant response to the invasion. And by 2100 the Pantagrueli military would release the casualties of the resulting fighting to the public.

[b]Pantagrueli Armed Forces(PAF)[/b]: 600 KIA, 1.300 Captured or MIA, 2.000 Injured
[b]Amarallo Peoples Liberation Resistance(APLR):[/b] 3.000 KIA, 8.000 Captured or MIA, 6.000 Injured

[1.31.25]
A Febuary eve Victory Parade would be held all over Pyongyang, Hanuel, Jangmokjin, Gyeolha, and Yongchukdo celebrating the Pantagrueli victory against a foreign power, people all over the country would celebrate and wave Pantagrueli flags representing the patriotism they have for their country. Meanwhile, in Haemyung, General Pak Ryun-sek would be given administration over the captured territories and would be responsible for the integration of these lands into Pantagruel. 

[2.1.25]
 APLR commander Jin Seok-ho would officially release a proclamation to all APLR members announcing the dissolution of the Faction and the laying off of all members within the Military Group. By 1200, the Pantagrueli Army would begin the streaming of the execution of all captured APLR members, over 2.000 people would be killed over a 2 hour time span, by 1430, Jin Seok-ho would stoned to death, but would also get the chance to say his final words before his death. His words were quoted [i]Though my body is captured, our spirit remains unbroken. The chains of the Pantagrueli oppressors will shatter. Amarallo will rise. Freedom will bloom, and democracy will flourish. The struggle has only begun. Let the fires of resistance burn eternal![/i]

By 1500, Jin Seok-ho would be pronounced dead and the live stream would end.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Lavian Civil Defense Radio News Issue #1]

Somewhere on Seger Military Base, a radio plays in one of the museums restoration hangers.

And I bet finally when I leave this war torn land; The last thing Ill see will be, although I may be in a drunken stupor, I bet itll be a garet trooper garet trooper Yah theyre all over the place, hardly worth going to war no more

A few seconds of silence are afforded to the hanger before the radio host enables his mic and sends his voice all over the nation to those tuned in.

You are listening to 96.7 Civil Defence radio, for all you youngins and vets who are feeling patriotic today. I hope I aint intruding too much on your musical attitude, but it's time for our scheduled news break. 
In domestic matters, recurring listeners will remember our recent talks about the progress of the Armys tank development helped by our northern ally, the UREV. Although it is particularly classified, the head of armored development assures us that they have made good progress, and they plan to have at least two working prototypes in a few month's time. 

The gas company Calpers, along with Vince Incorporated are beginning to lay the first sections of the Shamat-Raiara pipeline after the most recent acquisition of natural gas rich land in the north of West Shamat. The government is still choosing who to give rights to the aluminum to, so they will likely put sections of it up for auction, although the military has already set up a small area to extract from in the meantime. Same situation for the lithium and coal, but those will most likely go to other mining firms. On that note, we will have a guest host from that region on the show next week, so yall will be able to hear what he thinks of this whole self sufficiency based expansion stuff. Down to the south, oil drilling is going well. Politicians are meeting on Saynala this week to discuss a potential oil deal with our neighbor Henaiia in the exact same region as well.

And now for some foreign news. Anrakan has made a deal with Speerland, giving them access to open water while dividing Speerland. Audaraiun expands west onto a few islands, Cacalle expands to the south, giving them much more shoreline and access to iron. Also, in minor news, the leading map producer has decided to change the color of Schodenia from a somewhat teal to a goldish-yellow, but thats just something I noticed.
That ends our news segment for this week. I hope yall didnt mind listening to this old man, but its time to get back to your music

[/spoiler]

Hello everyone, here is the latest update for Erene: 2000!
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2606469

[b]Changes[/b]
[nation]Pantagruel[/nation] expands
[nation]Gendarme[/nation] expands
[nation]Vanwenor[/nation] added as Eraneroth
[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation] expands
[nation]Anraka0[/nation] expands

Also, a little announcement from us. Starting from the next update, we will be changing the way we go around handling expansions on Erene: 2000! The new system will work as follows:

From now on, you may claim up to 10,000 pixels in one go. However, you cannot write one post to permanently cement it as your land. You must write an appropriate amount of words proportional to the size of your expansion. At the current moment, one word is worth 10 pixels.

These words can be on anything, so long as it is related to your expansion. It could be worldbuilding in dispatches/our wiki or a chain of posts that tell a story set in your new land. So long as it contributes to the development of your new territory, all is good and we will let it pass.

Monitoring the amount of words you have written will work like this: every update, we will check in on the people that have expanded to see how many words they have written in a thread that will be called "Expansion Checkpoint". For people who operate solely from NationStates, please reply to update announcements with the amount of words you have written. It is on you to be honest with how much writing you have really done. If you have made no progress on your expansion by 5 updates, it will be declared void and we will revert the expansion. We define no progress as either seeing no actual writing happen on your behalf or no change to the number of words you have written.

Enjoy the new system!
